changelog:
Initial release: enables answering in classical Chinese prose (“wenyanwen”) with flexible register control for all OpenClaw outputs.

- Replies default to concise, classical prose (典雅正宗) for all tasks, including technical queries.
- Supports switching among six distinct classical Chinese registers by user command.
- Preserves technical terms, code, and necessary modern text within classical explanations.
- Allows exceptions: plain language given only when explicitly requested.
- Maintains chosen register across the session until changed.
- Provides clear contract and best practices for clarity, precision, and style adherence.
summary: Force OpenClaw replies into classical Chinese prose for general Q&A, writing, coding help, and daily work; supports iwenyan style switching across six Wenyan...
